summary: Michael G. Blair, 33, missing from Fairplay; last seen departing the Valley of the Sun area on foot carrying a splitboard and avalanche float bag, believed near Alma (CR 14/Venture Rd/Mountain View Dr); Park County SAR and the Sheriff's Office searched; never recovered
location: Valley of the Sun / Pennsylvania Mountain area, near Alma
responding_agency: Park County Search and Rescue, Park County Sheriff's Office
notes: Park County SO cold-case file (case S20-0110, reported missing by family 2020-02-06); outcome per twin brother's fundraiser: Blair died in the Mosquito Range in early 2020, body not recovered as of the fundraiser. Incident-focused summary; no profiling.
